about: The address the site is published at. The link-preview image (og:image, twitter:image) must be an absolute address, so the build writes it from here. Change it when the site moves to your own domain, then run python build.py.

accounts.about: Optional accounts (Part B). One Supabase project per region; paste its Project URL and its public anon key (Supabase dashboard, Project Settings, API), then run python build.py. Both empty: no account code can connect and the Sign in button stays hidden.
